mostWorthwhile.text: Making charcoal in the kiln was worthwhile because the explanation showed how limiting air turns heated wood into fuel.

leastWorthwhile.text: The awning and puppet felt like detours while I was trying to make bellows.

surprise.text: Cloth and air made bellows with wooden boards, after combinations explicitly using cloth with planks and wood made other objects.

arbitrary.text: Using stone at the iron quarry produced iron ore, but I was unsure what the stone would do there.

continue.text: I would probably continue: the furnace sequence was clear and the charcoal explanation taught me something, though the early bellows guesses were less satisfying.
